import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Matrix, Vector

def mat(name, color):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = color
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.7
    return m

wood = mat("Wood", (0.45, 0.26, 0.12, 1))
seatwood = mat("Wood Light", (0.6, 0.38, 0.2, 1))

def make(name, boxes, loc, rot_z, mats):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    for (cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz, mi) in boxes:
        r = bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
        verts = r["verts"]
        bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=(sx, sy, sz), verts=verts)
        bmesh.ops.translate(bm, vec=(cx, cy, cz), verts=verts)
        for f in {f for v in verts for f in v.link_faces}:
            f.material_index = mi
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    for m in mats: me.materials.append(m)
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.location = loc
    ob.rotation_euler = (0, 0, rot_z)
    return ob

# Table: 1.6 x 1.0 top at 0.75
tb = [(0, 0, 0.73, 1.6, 1.0, 0.05, 0)]
for x in (-0.72, 0.72):
    for y in (-0.42, 0.42):
        tb.append((x, y, 0.355, 0.07, 0.07, 0.71, 0))
tb += [(0, 0.42, 0.65, 1.37, 0.03, 0.08, 0), (0, -0.42, 0.65, 1.37, 0.03, 0.08, 0),
       (0.72, 0, 0.65, 0.03, 0.77, 0.08, 0), (-0.72, 0, 0.65, 0.03, 0.77, 0.08, 0)]
make("Table", tb, (0, 0, 0), 0, [wood])

# Chair local: seat centered, back at +Y side
cb = [(0, 0, 0.45, 0.45, 0.45, 0.04, 1)]
for x in (-0.19, 0.19):
    for y in (-0.19, 0.19):
        h = 0.95 if y > 0 else 0.43
        cb.append((x, y, h/2, 0.04, 0.04, h, 0))
cb += [(0, 0.19, 0.88, 0.42, 0.03, 0.12, 1), (0, 0.19, 0.68, 0.42, 0.03, 0.06, 1)]
# place: back faces away from table
places = [((0, -0.85, 0), math.radians(0)), ((0, 0.85, 0), math.radians(180)),
          ((-1.15, 0, 0), math.radians(-90)), ((1.15, 0, 0), math.radians(90))]
# check orientation: back at local +Y; for chair at -Y side back should point -Y -> rotate 180
places = [((0, -0.85, 0), math.pi), ((0, 0.85, 0), 0),
          ((-1.15, 0, 0), math.pi/2), ((1.15, 0, 0), -math.pi/2)]
for i, (loc, rz) in enumerate(places, 1):
    make(f"Chair {i}", cb, loc, rz, [wood, seatwood])
# verify back direction
for i in range(1,5):
    o = bpy.data.objects[f"Chair {i}"]
    print(o.name, tuple(round(c,2) for c in (o.matrix_world @ Vector((0,0.19,0.88)))))
